observations: Historical grab input translates hand and world/slot selection into a tactical request carrying actor, a wrapping sequence, expected equipment revision, expected held item and destination. Client preview and selection do not establish server admission or mutation; transport, retry, sequence exhaustion and server authority remain independent obligations.

Weapon and holder rendering checks encoded recipe length, generator version, decoding and design hash before using mesh caches. Runtime armor can use its procedural presentation; an absent or invalid holder stays visually absent while other missing generated visuals can use a physical box. This is presentation behavior, not proof of correct combat geometry, asset safety or an obsolete compatibility path.

Attachment lookup follows bounded parent chains with cycle detection and resolves equipment locations to semantic rig bones. World targeting computes a camera-directed bounded candidate set, line-of-sight filter and door/window inside checks before selection. Units, occlusion, topology and actual server targeting require connected source review.

Icon/cache/replication-order, selection and attachment source tests were read without execution. The separately referenced icons, preview, update, slot, skin and runtime modules were not credited. No product build, test or runtime probe ran.
